thread:
tanya: quick sync — i'm drafting the v2 migration plan. main constraint: avoid quota / billing spikes for dedicated customers when we flip routing. thoughts on detection vs. explicit opt-in?
ben: +1 on being conservative. detection is useful but we should smooth quota windows. simple idea: don't immediately move quota buckets when a key is enrolled. instead apply exponential moving average to token rate used for 24h.
alex: agree. concrete config suggestion:
```yaml
routing:
  probe_percentage: 0.05
  ramp_window_hours: 48
  quota_smoothing_alpha: 0.2
  sticky_for_hours: 6
```
ben: sticky_for_hours prevents thrash if clients flip back quickly. quota_smoothing_alpha=0.2 means new assignment affects quota calc slowly.
lina: how do we surface this in console? product wants per-customer projection of expected token delta if they opt into v2. can we produce a 'projected cost impact' panel from telemetry? metric names: v2.rollout.assignments, api.tokens.per_key, quota.adjusted_tokens, api.latency.p50_by_model
opsbot: telemetry: new counter emitted on routing decision: `routing.decision.{key}.{result}` with labels {reason=probe|explicit, target=v1|v2, model}. also emit `rollout.projection.{key}` with projected delta tokens in last_24h.
alex: idea to reduce noise: only compute projections for keys with >= 1000 tokens/day or enterprise flag. that keeps console useful and cheap.
ben: automation note: if projection > 20% delta we should block auto-route unless customer has 'auto-migrate' enabled. otherwise require console action or opt-in header.
tanya: UX for ops: add a console toggle on customer page "Auto-migrate to v2 (recommended)" with tooltip about smoothing and projected delta. also expose an opt-out header: `X-Api-Client-Override: version=v1` for clients that need time.
deploy-bot: :rocket: canary deploy started: v2-router group=prod-3, rollout=5% at 2025-11-12T14:02Z. monitor: api.errors.rate, api.latency.p95, quota.adjusted_tokens.delta
alex: quick runbook snippet for rollout alarms: if api.errors.rate > 2x baseline for 15m -> rollback to previous routing config; if quota.adjusted_tokens.delta > 50% increase for any enterprise key -> pause probe for that account and notify SE.
tanya: consensus? shout if objections, otherwise i'll file RFC and add console mockups. :thumbsup:
